source: Complete eleven-PR REST metadata and current-head check/status collection through 2026-10-18T21:17:12.925Z, followed by a separately dated Commons Lang metadata/discussion supplement after the coordinator posted one CI-admission comment. All other observations retain their individual full-batch timestamps. GraphQL reviewDecision remains unreported.

supplementary_findings.finding: The maintainer reports contacting the contributor by email about the CLA. The failing CLA context remains. No email was accessed, comment sent or legal assent inferred.

Submitted head and base match the coordinator source. At the full-batch observation, three upstream workflows required admission and their job collections were empty, with zero CheckRuns and StatusContexts. The later supplement verified one coordinator admission comment, zero inline comments/reviews, and unchanged source/open state; no CI observation was refreshed.
All nine current workflows and 54 CheckRuns remain successful; the separate AppVeyor status succeeds. Earlier full TSan success applies to this unchanged head and is not a current blocker.

timestamp_semantics: UTC timestamps sampled with JavaScript Date immediately before and after individual awaited connector reads. Date was checked against the UTC clock tool at 21:15:17 UTC. Top-level observation is collection completion; per-record timestamps identify actual read completion, not source event time.
